reviews.x: Did my daughters whole head of hair in less than an hour! The waves look super cute. It warms up fast and it's easy to use
I love this hair tool! So easy to use, and look how cute!

I have thick hair and it usually takes more than an hour to curl my hair, but with this waver wand it only took half an hour to make it look that nice. I love it! It’s so easy to use. It warms up fast, but doesn’t burn hair. So worth the money! Highly recommend it.

I wanted a wave iron, so when this one was on sale, I immediately purchased it. I used it on the lowest heat bc I have long highlighted hair. It was surprisingly easy to use and handle. It made great waves that lasted for days. I seldom use heat on my hair but I will definitely use this iron! Great price! Excellent product!

reviews.t: Easy to use and the curls lasts!!!
reviews.x: Let me first tell you about my hair- I have that super straight, fine zero-volume kinda hair that doesn't hold a curl to save my life. I tried this curling iron and it was extremely easy to use on my hair by myself and made my hair look beautifully wavey in no time. It also held ALL day which was impressive for my hair. I did add some hair spray which I'm sure helped too but normally my hair is flat or just frizzy after a few hours. I'm so pleased with this barrel curling iron that I've already

I have been wanting one of these tools but I didn’t want to invest a lot of money if I ended up not liking it. This iron is fabulous! Heats up quickly. Just as pictured. Definitely worth the price. Recommend
Very easy to use. Love the larger barrels and love that I don’t have to kill my hand squeezing it shut!

This product works so well! My hair never holds a curl and doesn't stay straight for very long, so I didn't have high expectations. This item surpassed everything! I have been using it for two weeks now and LOVE it. I did my hair on day 1 hair and it looked great. THE CURLS/WAVES STAYED IN TACT UNTIL I NEEDED TO WASH ON DAY 3! Of course I did have to fix a few pieces here and there, but overall, my hair stayed wavy for three days! The only downside to this product is that my hair smelled after t

reviews.t: Perfect to get those instagram waves!
reviews.x: Perfect to get those Instagram waves! I would say this if for short to medium hair based on the size of the barrel. It worked great and I’ve used it a couple of times a week since I have gotten it. I love that it has the two best settings as well, I choose the higher one, but my sister had fine hair and needed to use the lower setting. Both of our hair looked great!

For the price it is good. It gets really hot... like so hot I burned my shoulder when it hit for a split second. The clamp isn’t super tight with the hair so you gotta be careful not to pull it. It does leave a bit of a crease at the top and takes practice to get it right. Overall I really like it
I have wanted to try this style of curling iron for a while so glad I finally got one. I love It and received so many compliments on my hair.
it’s easy to used, I use one time can keep 2day ,I like it !

I gotta start off by saying that I initially had no faith in this curling iron, the only reason I purchased was because I had a promo code and I got it for real cheap, so I figured less than $15 wasnt going to brake the bank. Well Im here to tell you now that I super love this curling iron! I have very, very thick hair and honestly it works sooooo good! It super easy to use, even my 9 year old uses it on her hair (with supervision of course!) I definitely recommend!

Pretty simple to use, and has two heat settings which I appreciate the simplicity of. The switch locks into place well enough that you don’t accidentally turn it iff while using it. I find that the hotter setting is good if you like to just work fast. But the  low setting is better for a beginner. Smooth surface and a thoughtful design. Has a little foot for when you  set it down. Definitely a good price point for what you get.

This hair waver thing is magic. I cannot curl my hair to save my life.  I used it right out of the box and it actually does exactly what it says it does.  I've tried curl rods, tiktok hair thingy with scrunchies and long tube, but THIS actually did what it promised! So easy to use. I'm so excited to practice and get my waves perfect.

My hair is thin and fine but this was awful still. I could feel the heat near my head. It steamed when using. I burned my shoulder. The curl didn't last and it looked cheaply done. Not nice or professional. I used it when my 2 year was napping there's no way I could use it around him. Returning.

I didn’t have much big of a hope for this, after use it I thought the curve or more of a wave was a little way too obvious like a wave, but it loosened up little bit throughout the day. I was just happy with how much compliments I got from curling my hair, lol

reviews.t: Easy to use, hair come out really cute.
reviews.x: Bought this for my niece and her hair comes out super cute. It was really easy to do her hair and made perfect crimps without harming her hair. Warms up quickly. Im not very good with hair and this was easy for me to use. Would recommend for even beginners.

Absolutely love love this! My hair doesn’t curl easily,  but with this it was perfect! The only thing I would recommend is to wear a heat glove when you’re using it. I get a lot of compliments when I do my hair with this.
Super easy to use! If you can use a hair straightener, then you can use this waver! I always get tons of compliments when I do my hair with this tool!! It’s my new favorite and it doesn’t take long!
It heats up super fast! Also it works amazing! I honestly was unsure about it when ordering but so glad I did because I absolutely love it! Can do my hair in 5 minutes or less!
Love it- hair is flat and wanted some waves. Changing hair color and having to take steps for the silver color. Product help me with looking great and style
This iron made great beach waves. Very relaxed curl, and just what I wanted. Because it has three barrels it cuts the time in half. I also love the color.
So easy to use and works great on my hair. Works especially good when I'm in a hurry , this a great way to add volume without spending too much time
Love it fell in love with it leaves hair curly 😍 so easy to use you can finish in minutes of using it. Super easy to use that leaves your hair curly

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the waver as easy to use, even for those who struggle with curling their hair.
Many reviewers praise how quickly it heats up and how fast it styles hair, including thick hair.
Several reviewers report that the waves or curls last a long time, sometimes for days.
Multiple reviewers consider it good value for the price and worth the money.
One reviewer notes negatives: it gets very hot (causing a burn), the clamp isn't tight, and it leaves a crease requiring practice.
